title: Gamelan Glint Cloud
description: A granular metallic percussion cloud built from a mangled metal dirt sample — chopped into 12 grains, pitch-mangled with squiz, and run through a drifting bandpass filter for a tropical-gamelan shimmer. Over 16 cycles the filter center, stereo pan, and playback speed all travel on mutually-prime LFO clocks (7, 13, 16 cycles) so the cloud never repeats, glinting like sun bouncing off corrugated tin on a beach.
